value.description_html:
Marley Herringbone White Oak Engineered Hardwood by Westridge offers the perfect blend of beauty and durability for your home. Engineered hardwood is real hardwood that is highly stable and less prone to expanding and shrinking from changes in moisture and temperature. This flooring adds warmth and character to any room, providing a sophisticated touch.

  • Crafted from White Oak, this engineered hardwood showcases a timeless and elegant appearance, enhancing the aesthetic of your space.
  • With a hardness rating of 3, this flooring provides excellent durability, making it suitable for high-traffic areas in your home.
  • The versatile installation methods include glue, nail, or staple, allowing for flexible installation based on your specific needs and preferences.
  • Backed by a 50-year residential and 5-year commercial warranty, this flooring ensures long-lasting performance and peace of mind for years to come.

Keep your floors clean by using a dry microfiber mop, soft-bristle brush, or vacuum without a beater bar. Marley Herringbone White Oak Engineered Hardwood has a wire-brushed finish with an approximate thickness of 1/2 inch.

category.description: Category slug (cgid) such as `porcelain-tile` or `oak-wood`; filters on the product's primary category. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,80}$.

page.description:
Zero-based page.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 99.

query.description: Keyword query; empty or omitted to browse by filters.

size.description: Exact size facet value as the site writes it, e.g. `12 x 24`.

sort.description:
Storefront sort order.

Provider reference: allowed values ["most_popular", "newest", "relevant", "price_asc", "price_desc", "trending"].

store_id.description: Restrict to products available at this store and report its unit price as `store_price`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,4}$.

200.description:
Search or browse the Floor & Decor US catalog through the storefront's Algolia products index: keyword query, optional category slug, brand, color, finish, size and store filters, six sort orders, paginated with facet counts. Prices are USD; store-specific prices come from the record's per-store price map when `store_id` is given.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `products` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `brand` | string |  |
| `color` | string |  |
| `finish` | string |  |
| `id` | string |  |
| `image_url` | string | Main product image (Amplience CDN), https. |
| `in_stock` | boolean |  |
| `manufacturer_sku` | string |  |
| `master` | boolean | True for a collection/master record rather than a sellable SKU. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `package_price` | number | Price in USD of the selling package (box, carton or piece) as the site lists it; Algolia `regularPrice`. |
| `primary_category_id` | string | Category slug (cgid), usable as `category` in search_products. |
| `product_type` | string |  |

| `size` | string |  |
| `store_price` | number | Unit price at the requested `store_id` (Algolia `storePricing.store{id}`; the range minimum for a collection record); null when no store was requested or the store has no price. |
| `store_price_max` | number | Upper end of the store price range for a collection/variant master record; null for a single price. |
| `unit` | string | Measure the unit price is quoted in as the site writes it, e.g. `/sqft` or `/each`; Algolia `soldBy`. |
| `unit_price` | number | Price in USD per selling measure (`unit`, e.g. per sqft); Algolia `price.USD`. |
